name: ky-corporate-income-tax
description: Cayman Islands companies for 2026. No corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax or minimum top-up tax; an exempted company can get a tax undertaking for up to 30 years under the Tax Concessions Act. The tax work is economic substance under the International Tax Co-operation (Economic Substance) Act (2026 Revision) - annual notification, a report within 12 months of year end for relevant entities doing a relevant activity, and penalties of CI$5,000 plus CI$500 a day, CI$10,000 and CI$100,000; the reduced test for pure equity holding companies; and country-by-country reporting for groups of US$850 million. Trigger on Cayman corporate tax, Cayman exempted company tax, Cayman economic substance, tax undertaking certificate Cayman. Built from Cayman legislation; not reviewed by an accountant.
